consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: 600−800 g/m2 with notched trowel B3 (TKB Germany) e.g. for lam parquet, mosaic parquet and industrial parquet.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: 700−900 g/m2 with notched trowel B6 (TKB Germany) or SC+ MB (US Standard) e.g. for engineered wood strips and planks, lam and mosaic parquet.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: 800−1000 g/m2 with notched trowel B11 (TKB Germany) or P5 (US Standard) e.g. solid wood, engineered long-strips and panels, industrial parquet, other residential wood floors and paving, and chipboard.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: For bonding long or wide boards and on uneven substrates, it may be necessary to use a larger notched trowel to ensure that a sufficient amount of SikaBond® T-55 J is applied to provide a uniform adhesive bed to prevent hollow sections without full surface bond

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: For substrates primed with Sika® Primer MB, the consumption of SikaBond® T-55 J may be reduced.

compat.text: SikaBond® T-55 J is designed for full surface wood floor bonding of solid and engineered wood floors and subfloors.
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Suitable for use with underfloor heating
compat.heading: FEATURES

compat.text: Suitable for bonding directly onto old ceramic tiles
compat.heading: FEATURES

compat.text: SikaBond® T-55 J is only suitable for use by professional wood floor applicators.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Before wood floors may be installed in non-insulated areas, such as basements or other areas without a damp proof membrane, Sikafloor® EpoCem must be applied and sealed with Sika® Primer MB to control the moisture
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use on polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE / Teflon), and other similar plasticized synthetic materials.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Broadcast mastic asphalt must be primed with Sika® Primer MB. Refer to the Product Data Sheet for further application details.
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: SikaBond® T-55 J can be used without priming on cement based floors, anhydrite floors, chipboards, concrete and ceramic tiles.
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: For broadcasted mastic asphalt, cement based floors with excessive moisture content and use over old adhesive residues or on weak substrates use Sika® Primer MB. For detailed instructions contact our Technical Service Department.
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: Fresh, uncured adhesive on the wood floor surface must be removed immediately with a clean cloth and if necessary also cleaned with Sika® Remover-208 or Sika®TopClean-T. Always test wood floor surfaces for compatibility with Sika® Cleaner-208 before use
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

precautionary_statements.text: P210 Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, open flames and other ignition sources. No smoking.

precautionary_statements.statement: Do not breathe mist or vapours.
precautionary_statements.text: P260 Do not breathe mist or vapours.
P273 Avoid release to the environment.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wear protective gloves/ protective clothing/ eye protection/ face protection/ hearing protection.
precautionary_statements.text: P280 Wear protective gloves/ protective clothing/ eye protection/ face protection/ hearing protection.

precautionary_statements.statement: Get medical advice/ attention if you feel unwell.
precautionary_statements.text: P314 Get medical advice/ attention if you feel unwell.

precautionary_statements.statement: In case of fire: Use dry sand, dry chemical or alcohol-resistant foam to extinguish.
precautionary_statements.text: P370 + P378 In case of fire: Use dry sand, dry chemical or alcohol-resistant foam to extinguish.
P403 Store in a well-ventilated place.

precautionary_statements.statement: Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.
precautionary_statements.text: P501 Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Store in original container. Keep in a well-ventilated place. Observe label precautions. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). For personal protection see section 8. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3 Protective clothing needs to be made of cotton.

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
